chambers.name: Senate
notes: Special elections and subsequent vacancies are outside the regular-election baseline.

October 3 nationwide review: reported presidential baselines and current terms come from MultiState; Open States provides a roster cross-check. These compilations do not replace primary certification.
Holdovers follow the reported current-term roster with reconciled totals. Verification here means roster and seat-count checks; it does not certify every seat against a primary state notice.

Independent-only opposition uses an estimated presidential crosswalk. When D/R and other candidates all run, other-candidate strength uses a broad uncalibrated latent-score prior (−30, standard deviation 20). These are not observed vote forecasts.
District residual error is at least 10 points. Historical diagnostics are limited to selected contested single-member races; the full chamber model is not calibrated.

drivers.label: State-specific adjustment
drivers.explanation: Unavailable state data uses a zero-centered prior; a manual state scenario is additive.

drivers.label: External signal adjustment
drivers.explanation: Only numeric, timestamped, deduplicated signals contribute. Qualitative ratings are comparison-only. Maximum combined weight 15% and ±3 margin points.

drivers.label: Current D share of filled partisan seats
drivers.explanation: Current seat balance anchors anonymous latent-seat margins when district results are unavailable.
